name: DFA - Founder Demo Form to Gamma Deck

parameters.formDescription: Create a 3-5 slide Gamma-ready financial snapshot, peer benchmark, strategic insight, and executive proposal outline. Uses free/public sources only: SEC, company IR/public pages, and public search discovery.

values.placeholder: Type a name or write pick for me
Optional: paste investor relations page, annual report URL, known peers, service angle, or company notes.

values.formSubmittedText: Gamma deck outline generated. Review the workflow output.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ q: $('Normalize Form Inputs').first().json.state.inputs.company_name + ' investor relations annual report earnings release transcript restructuring acquisition executive changes', num: 10 }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-sonnet-4-6', max_tokens: 5000, temperature: 0.45, system: 'You are an AI financial analyst who thinks like Aswath Damodaran and writes concise Gamma AI presentation outlines. Evidence-first, skeptical, transparent. Never fabricate numbers. If missing, write N/A and explain. Do not use templating placeholders or curly-brace variables in the final deck content.', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Create a founder-presentable Gamma AI deck outline with ' + $json.state.inputs.slide_count + ' slides. The deck must condense these required internal deliverables: company and source pack, financial snapshot, peer comparison, three strategic insights, ratio dashboard, executive proposal, read-between-lines signals, assumptions/data gaps, and insight-to-value selling ideas. Return valid JSON only with keys gamma_markdown, slides_json, missing_data_notes, suggested_gamma_theme. Each slide must include title, subtitle, concise bullets, speaker notes, suggested visual, and source notes. Use only the provided data. No paid APIs. No invented numbers. INPUT_JSON: ' + JSON.stringify($json.state).slice(0, 120000) }] }) }}
